2.15.2 Subreport.Style
The Subreport.Style element specifies style properties for a Subreport. This element is optional. This
element is of type Style.
Following is the parent element of the Subreport.Style element.
Parent elements
Subreport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.Style element.
 <xsd:element name="Style" type="StyleType" minOccurs="0"/>
